artifact_policy: Ignored local models/configs/logs; tracked task, real PostgreSQL regressions and evidence. No CI gate.

setup_incident.reason: initdb --no-locale defaulted to SQL_ASCII; pgx simple protocol requires UTF8 client encoding. Both full gates will rerun on UTF8.

limits: Finite safety; no unbounded, refinement or composition theorem, fairness/liveness, full Server process restart or physical network faults.
Phase model: one deleting Project, one/two Runs, optional Audit/Eval blockers, one/two items in each abstract cleanup group and batch one/two; child execution and release are environmental events.

Claim model: one/two controllers, at most three/four acquisitions, initial phase cancelling or purging_artifacts, two items and batch one. Unique symbolic tokens stand for opaque ClaimIDs, not a Project epoch column.

Expiry allows replacement; only a changed ID revokes the old claim. Phase/purge check ID+phase; release/defer accept the same ID after phase advance. Late Run cancellation/deletion retain independent lifecycle authority.

PostgreSQL atomicity, row locks, constraint arbitration, clock comparisons and noncolliding ClaimID generation are assumptions checked separately where covered; exact timeout margins and all child-controller paths are not proved.

Receipt/Finding internals are an aggregate cleanup group. The model allows final receipt and Artifact work in one transaction; Project mutation-receipt work actually commits separately. Per-table order and byte budgets remain concrete-store concerns.

Restart tests construct new Controller objects over the real database, abandon the old step result/bookkeeping and explicitly expire fixture timestamps. Locked-batch test uses the actual claim lock and Artifact purge tail in a fixture without Eval/Finding/receipts.
Full Go package execution includes existing 50000-revision, receipt/Eval and 60000-Run read-plan fixtures. No heavy IO opt-in was enabled; only declared policy skips may be accepted.
No production defect established or production/schema/API changed; no automatic CI adoption.
reopen_when: Project lifecycle and persistence owners revisit phases, drain gates, claims, transaction ownership or cleanup ordering.
